title: Within-provider OpenRouter paired re-run after retrieval, token-budget, and client-fallback repairs

scope.control: Gate 12-V frozen OpenRouter run: same 40 questions, same provider, same configured models.

b3_decision.reasoning: The Groq lane cannot run: a single free key produced 67 rate-limit errors in 108 requests under organization-level OTPM/ITPM limits, and key rotation is permanently ruled out (RISK-0009, DEC-0033). It is therefore not a real product alternative, and comparing against a lane that cannot serve answers a question nobody is asking. The correct control is Gate 12-V's own frozen OpenRouter run — same 40 questions, same metric definitions, same provider, same models. That is a within-provider before/after, which isolates exactly what this arc changed (retrieval top_k 5→10, the max_tokens repair, the client-side fallback repair) far more cleanly than a cross-provider comparison ever could.
b3_decision.spot_check: Skipped; no Groq request is a control in this protocol.

repairs_under_test: RAG_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS now reaches the provider wire as max_tokens=2048
OpenRouter typed primary failures trigger a separate fallback request; each request is ledger-counted and Retry-After is honored

frozen_token_f1.normalization: NFKC, whitespace collapse, casefold, Unicode \w+ tokens, multiset symmetric F1
frozen_token_f1.continuity: Report side by side with Gate 12-V original.

corrected_metric.numeric_normalization: Canonicalize digit runs to integer form, e.g. 07 -> 7 and 02 -> 2.
corrected_metric.preamble_normalization: Strip only the observed leading phrase Theo ngữ cảnh đã truy xuất,.
corrected_metric.score: Report normalized symmetric token-F1 and expected-token containment recall.
corrected_metric.validation_boundary: The corrected automated score is not assumed to be validated; hand-adjudicate all 36 answerable rows and report disagreement.

metrics.hand_adjudication: For every answerable row, record correct, partial, wrong, or refused against the question and expected answer; report counts and disagreement against both automated metrics.
metrics.citation_and_system_metrics: Reuse Gate 12-V definitions and Wilson 95% intervals; report raw numerators/denominators.
metrics.availability: Report primary 502 count, fallback activation count, served model per request, provider-availability refusals versus evidence-based refusals.
metrics.wire_audit: For every captured generation POST report max_tokens_present and value; retain successful-response end timestamps and per-POST latency.

corrected_arithmetic.source: B0 hand adjudication and frozen Gate 12-V records; no golden fields edited
corrected_arithmetic.fallback_projection: B2 fallback repair can recover five refused-but-retrieved rows at the observed 13/16 served-and-retrieved quality; seven refused-and-not-retrieved rows have a conservative 5/8 recovery estimate. This yields approximately 26/36 before the additional top_k effect.
corrected_arithmetic.retrieval_ceiling_interpretation: The 88/116 and 104/116 figures are conservative lower bounds, not exhaustive upper bounds: five answerable rows were human-correct despite the annotated relevant_chunk_ids not being retrieved. Relevant-chunk annotations are not exhaustive.

thresholds.quality_gap_openrouter_minus_groq_min: not applicable under DEC-0038; no Groq control

attribution_policy.retrieval: Attribute only retrieval/top_k changes to retrieved IDs and refusal differences; the 88->110 annotation/ranking gap remains open.
attribution_policy.max_tokens: Attribute only wire presence, completion lengths, finish_reason=length, and usage changes; do not infer answer correctness causality without isolation.
attribution_policy.fallback: Attribute availability recovery only when a primary typed failure is followed by a separately captured Gemma request and served model.
attribution_policy.metric: Report frozen and corrected scores side by side; hand adjudication is the validation target.
attribution_policy.provider_variance: Report raw 502 and served-model counts; do not call a healthy Nemotron sample a stable reliability result.
